name: Honoring Thy Mother And Father
overview: The Scriptures firmly command believers to honor their parents, emphasizing this as a divine mandate with serious consequences for disobedience. Exodus 20:12 and Deuteronomy 5:16 highlight that honoring father and mother leads to a prolonged life and well-being in the land God provides. The gravity of this command is underscored in passages like Exodus 21:17 and Matthew 15:4, which pronounce severe judgment on those who curse their parents. Proverbs 30:17 vividly warns of dire repercussions for mocking or despising parental authority, while Matthew 19:19 connects honoring parents with the broader command to love one’s neighbor, framing it as foundational to Christian living.
